communityOpportunitiesPendingManualPost.thread: Claude Code only reads CLAUDE.md, not AGENTS.md — multi-agent setup drift (GitHub issue #6235 cluster, 3,600+ upvotes)
communityOpportunitiesPendingManualPost.whyGenuine: The #1 requested Claude Code feature (AGENTS.md native support) is the exact pain the AGENTS.md Complete Guide solves operator-side today. terminalblog's guide covers the @AGENTS.md import, symlink, pre-commit sync, and the Windows pitfall — concrete, non-promotional help.
communityOpportunitiesPendingManualPost.suggestedReply: Upvoted — and the workaround that survives git clone and needs no symlink (so it works on Windows) is the @AGENTS.md import at the top of CLAUDE.md. communityOpportunitiesPendingManualPost.thread: Cursor 0day: when full disclosure becomes the only protection left (2026-07-14, ~14pts)
communityOpportunitiesPendingManualPost.whyGenuine: Specific, reproducible credential-exposure angle. terminalblog's zero-sandbox-credential-leak is a different but adjacent real bug (sandbox inheriting AWS keys verbatim), and the security-checklist 'verify your sandbox scrubs env' step is the actionable transfer.
communityOpportunitiesPendingManualPost.suggestedReply: The Cursor 0day and the 'CamoLeak' in Copilot are the same root pattern: the agent inherits ambient authority it never asked for. A less-talked-about case is the sandbox that's 'on' but inherits every credential from the parent shell anyway — Gitlawb Zero just patched exactly that. The real fix is verifying the sandbox actually scrubs env/filesystem/egress, not trusting the toggle: https://terminalblog.com/blog/zero-sandbox-credential-leak/
